option_relations.rationale: Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma (TMBC) is a specific type of cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma.

Carcinoma erysipeloides is a clinical presentation of cutaneous metastasis, and TMBC can be considered a variant or a related entity within the broader category of cutaneous metastasis from breast carcinoma.
The option is identical to the provided leaf label.

Carcinoma en cuirasse is another clinical variant of cutaneous metastasis from breast carcinoma, and while distinct, it falls under the broader umbrella of breast carcinoma metastasis, which can include TMBC.
